component.name: arraw
component.summary: RAW photo editor with a GPU preview

description.p: arraw is a RAW processing engine with a desktop application and a command line on top. Open a photograph or a folder, develop it non-destructively with a preview rendered on the GPU, and export. It is still being rebuilt, and not every feature of a full RAW editor exists yet.

ul.li: Reads RAW files from most cameras (through LibRaw), plus JPEG, PNG and TIFF
Non-destructive editing: settings live in an XMP sidecar beside the photograph
Colour-managed development in a linear Rec.2020 working space
Exposure, tone controls, white balance, tone curves, black and white conversion and colour grading
Texture, clarity, dehaze, noise reduction, vignette and grain
Local adjustments through linear and radial masks, up to sixteen per photograph
Ratings and colour labels, a filterable film strip and an edit history
Export to JPEG, PNG or TIFF in sRGB, Display P3 or Adobe RGB, with chosen metadata
A command line for batch export and inspection, with no display needed
